facts.fact: ITWeb Africa reports Raxio Group operates data centres in Ethiopia (among six countries) as carrier-neutral colocation; no event date given, so as_of is the article's published date.

ITWeb Africa reports that Raxio's data centres, including its Ethiopia facility, are all Tier III certified (operator's statement; certifying body not named); no event date given, so as_of is the article's published date.

note: Pan-African funding story; Ethiopia named among countries operated in.
